CharacterModifierDef.description:
An attribute modifier a race or class gives its player, the same at every level: levels give stat points to
spend instead (Matěj, 2026-10-15, RLM-196). Units follow the stat rules: multiplied operations take percent
(``amount_percent``); ``add_value`` on one of our stats takes its unit (percent for a share, points otherwise); a
vanilla attribute takes either.

amount_percent.description: The amount in percent (5 means 5 %, the fraction 0.05).
amount_percent.title: Amount Percent

attribute.description: The attribute it modifies, e.g. realmforge:strength.
attribute.title: Attribute

operation.description: How the amount applies (vanilla's attribute modifier operations).
operation.title: Operation

CharacterModifierDef.title: CharacterModifierDef

ClassSpellDef.description:
A spell a class teaches its players at a level (C4): they learn it at rank 1 once they reach the level, and
keep it.

level.description: The character level that teaches it.
level.title: Level

ClassSpellDef.title: ClassSpellDef

KitItemDef.description: One item of a class's starting kit.

count.description: How many (1 to 64), split into full stacks.
count.title: Count

KitItemDef.title: KitItemDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

RageDef.description:
How a rage class gains and loses rage (architecture 11.5): from melee hits it deals and damage it takes, decaying
out of combat. The pool holds 100.

decay_after_seconds.description: How long after the last hit dealt or taken the holder is out of combat and its rage decays.
decay_after_seconds.title: Decay After Seconds

decay_per_second.description: Rage lost every second out of combat.
decay_per_second.title: Decay Per Second

per_hit_dealt.description: Rage for a full-strength melee hit dealt; a weaker swing gives its share.
per_hit_dealt.title: Per Hit Dealt

per_max_health_taken.description: Rage for taking damage equal to the whole max health from an attacker; a hit for a tenth of it gives a tenth.
per_max_health_taken.title: Per Max Health Taken

RageDef.title: RageDef

description:
A class: its role, its resource, the stats it gives, its spells by level and its starting kit (architecture
10.1). The specialization spell trees come with C5.

description.description: One or two sentences on character creation, in the lore style guide's voice.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

modifiers.description: Attribute modifiers the class gives, the same at every level.
modifiers.title: Modifiers

name.description: The class's name, shown on character creation and the character sheet (Title Case).

rage.description: How the class gains and loses rage; a rage class sets it, any other leaves it out.

resource.description: The resource its spells cost: realmforge:mana or realmforge:rage.
resource.title: Resource

role.description: What the class plays: melee, caster or ranged (assassins count as ranged). It decides which role-bound stat rule bonuses its players get (architecture 8.3).
role.title: Role

spells.description: The spells the class teaches by level (C4): one at level 1, and at most 4 per chapter in all (decision D4: chapter N allows 4 x N spells).
spells.title: Spells

starting_kit.description: Items a new character of this class receives once.
starting_kit.title: Starting Kit
